question: What happens to outward manifestation when supreme awareness reabsorbs it?
premises: Supreme awareness draws emission back into itself.
The same reality remains through that retraction.
Its outward form is dissolved in the fire of prior awareness.
inference: Therefore external manifestation is only a temporary form of the one reality reabsorbed by awareness.
uncertainties: prāgbodha could mean prior, original, or foundational awareness; the temporal nuance is interpretive.
plain_english: When supreme awareness draws emission back into itself, that same reality remains, while its outward form is dissolved in the fire of original awareness.
